_description: Block unfiltered env dumps (printenv, env, set, export, declare without a name) that could expose secrets, in the spellings a shell resolves to them: a path (/usr/bin/env), a wrapper (command, exec, sudo, env), sh -c or eval, a shell reading a here-document or here-string, or a substitution that names them ($(which env)). A here-document only fed to another program is data and not checked. A seatbelt against accidental dumps, not a boundary: keep tokens out of the agent environment
_usage: Add to PreToolUse Bash matcher in .claude/settings.json
